name: zombie_rider.live_native_impact_two_mcw
description: Dedicated native two-rider impact fixture for physical closing, named impact outcomes, cooldown/re-approach and independent single-attack arbitration.

steps.label: native_impact_fixture_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: two staged hostile zombie riders and full-health armored player load to live map

steps.label: audit_saved_native_impact_time
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove expected noon footing before native impact

steps.label: audit_saved_native_impact_passable_escape_lanes
steps.abort_reason: saved map audit did not prove every intended multi-tile east and south separation lane tile is t_floor/passable

steps.label: audit_saved_native_impact_two_rider_footing
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not prove two alive hostile riders at independent closing approaches

steps.label: operate_native_rider_impact_two
steps.objective: Use only advertised native World actions. Allow each rider to make a real physical closing step; capture one of the named impact outcomes, including damage/downing or armor/dodge resolution. Separate from contact through native movement and allow cooldown, then obtain a later impact opportunity only after a fresh closing step. Preserve per-rider native receipts, positions, timestamps, impact messages, health/downed state, cooldown and exact same-turn message ordering. Demonstrate both riders can pressure independently and that one rider's impact does not produce an ordinary bite or second strike in the same turn.
proof_targets: fresh closing approach and later impact opportunity
independent two-rider pressure and one-attack arbitration
invariants: no debug attack or target injection
no stationary adjacency credited as closing
no bite-only contact credited as impact
cooldown does not re-arm without a fresh closing step
no same-turn extra strike after impact

evidence_contract.claim: two current native zombie riders produce named physical impact outcomes with cooldown/re-approach and independent one-attack arbitration
evidence_contract.writeback_note: fixture setup earns no behavior credit; native closing receipts and named impact messages are required
